question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
What do you think of Ben and Denni?
Did you find Ben right away?

nodes.text: $ZOE spins through the air in a tight ball, her arms at her side, whipping her around with every rotation!
With her eyes open, she keeps a careful watch on the ground, uncoiling her body at just the right moment!
She sticks the landing! The crowd cheers!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Whoa! Go Centerscore!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Well, `that` was impressive! She's practically Queen already!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] was impressive! She's practically Queen already!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Eat it, Wilson High!
$ZOE spins through the air...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How do I keep my eyes at my side...?
Her body starts to unravel...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are my feet open...? What does that even mean?
She sinks toward the ground rapidly!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Am I falling? Wait, why are my eyes closed?! I can't tell where I am!
Smack! She lands right on her butt!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ow!
The crowd gasps! Then...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: That was embarrassing! I'll have to write-in a vote for her for Homecoming Klutz!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Ha! She just lost `my` vote! Princesses don't make mistakes!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ha! She just lost [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] vote! Princesses don't make mistakes!

nodes.text: The rest of the first half proceeds the same way, with Centerscore struggling on offense! But the defense keeps Wilson at bay, and the score is 17-3 at halftime!
In the stands...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: It's over...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Wilson's just too good!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: What's the point of playing the second half?!
Back on the sidelines...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's going on?! Every time we run a play on offense, Wilson's right there to stop us!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It's probably that new guy, Spencer!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What? Spencer's defense is the only reason we still have a chance in this game!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It is?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, haven't you been watching? He's made nearly every tackle!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, I've been watching, $ZOE, but football is like owning a dog that's too big for your purse... It just doesn't make sense!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What are we going to do for our halftime show?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I was just thinking...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: With this camera guy here, we have an opportunity to really become TV stars!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And since $ZOE's already decided to become one, I think it's time to give her that chance! She can be `the ball` in `The Fling!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And since $ZOE's already decided to become one, I think it's time to give her that chance! She can be [color=#3b78e2][i]the ball[/i][/color] in [color=#3b78e2][i]The Fling![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The cheerleaders gasp!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `The Fling!` But that stunt's illegal! It's been banned in like thirty states!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]The Fling![/i][/color] But that stunt's illegal! It's been banned in like thirty states!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Including ours!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I don't want to go to jail! Orange is my worst color!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: But you're wearing orange now...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh, right. I love orange! Whoo jail!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Don't worry, girls. It's not `that` dangerous! Besides, $ZOE is very good at learning new stunts! The worst that can happen is that she falls and embarrasses herself on live TV!
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't worry, girls. It's not [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] dangerous! Besides, $ZOE is very good at learning new stunts! The worst that can happen is that she falls and embarrasses herself on live TV!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Taylor, I don't know...
Taylor yanks $ZOE aside!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Listen, $ZOE! You've got two options! Either you go out there and be the best ball you can be, or you're off the team!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Fine! I'll do the stunt.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I thought so... And Amanda will be your guide!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Amanda? But she's...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yes?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Never mind...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: $ZOE! Yay! Are you ready?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Okay! Here's how it works! We pick you up and hurl you into the sky like a unicorn!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You have to curl up into a little ball and then uncurl at the right time so you don't embarrass yourself!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You'll be so pretty! And you'll get very dizzy!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's nice, Amanda... But how do I do it?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You only need to remember a couple of things for this stunt!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Keep your eyes at your side, keep your feet open, and remember to land on your butt!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Wait... That's not right, is it?
The cheerleaders scoop $ZOE up, rocking her back and forth!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Three!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Two!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh no! Amanda confused me with all those silly ideas! I'll just have to do what makes sense!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: One... Fling!
$ZOE gets flung into the air! The crowd gasps!

nodes.speaker: Cameraman
nodes.text: Great! Thanks! Perfect!
$ZOE returns to the cheerleaders...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: `That's` what you chose to say!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]That's[/i][/color] what you chose to say!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Everyone shouts out to their parents, $ZOE! It's so cliche and lame!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I thought it was nice...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, well, we'll have to work on that.
Meanwhile, on the field...
Zach throws a pass to Howard, but Skazz intercepts it and takes it all the way back for a touchdown!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: This is going to be easy!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Ha! What a bunch of losers!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Grr...

nodes.speaker: Cameraman
nodes.text: Great! Thanks! Perfect!
$ZOE returns to the cheerleaders...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: `That's` what you chose to say!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]That's[/i][/color] what you chose to say!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm so shocked! $ZOE loves Howard!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Maybe next time say something that everyone doesn't already know!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I thought it was nice...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, well, we'll have to work on that.
Meanwhile, on the field...
Zach throws a pass to Howard, but Skazz intercepts it and takes it all the way back for a touchdown!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: This is going to be easy!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Ha! What a bunch of losers!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Grr...

nodes.speaker: Cameraman
nodes.text: Great! Thanks! Perfect!
$ZOE returns to the cheerleaders...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: `That's` what you chose to say!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]That's[/i][/color] what you chose to say!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm all for school spirit, but `of course` you love Centerscore! You're wearing a Centerscore uniform!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm all for school spirit, but [color=#3b78e2][i]of course[/i][/color] you love Centerscore! You're wearing a Centerscore uniform!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I thought it was nice...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, well, we'll have to work on that.
Meanwhile, on the field...
Zach throws a pass to Howard, but Skazz intercepts it and takes it all the way back for a touchdown!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: This is going to be easy!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Ha! What a bunch of losers!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Grr...

nodes.speaker: Cameraman
nodes.text: Great! Thanks! Perfect!
$ZOE returns to the cheerleaders...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: At least you said something worthwhile...
After introductions... The stands are filled on both sides... The players are in position...
Skazz runs forward and kicks the ball high into the air, and the game begins!
Nearby, a man steps onto the sidelines with a large video camera!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, who's that?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I know exactly who that is... He's filming for TV! The game is being broadcast!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh my gosh!
The girls start jumping up and down excitedly!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Shh! Shh! Settle down... He's coming over here.

nodes.speaker: Cameraman
nodes.text: Hey, girls! Which one of you wants to be on TV?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Um, I think it's obvious which one of us `should` be on TV...
nodes.text_bbcode: Um, I think it's obvious which one of us [color=#3b78e2][i]should[/i][/color] be on TV...

nodes.speaker: Cameraman
nodes.text: Oh yeah?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, you want someone who embodies stardom. The cheerleader who best...

nodes.speaker: Cameraman
nodes.text: I'll film the short girl.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Who? $ZOE? You don't want to film her, she's more of a `backstage` actress than a spotlight one.
nodes.text_bbcode: Who? $ZOE? You don't want to film her, she's more of a [color=#3b78e2][i]backstage[/i][/color] actress than a spotlight one.

nodes.speaker: Cameraman
nodes.text: Yeah, $ZOE. Come here.
$ZOE hesitantly steps in front of the camera...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Benedict $ZOE strikes again...

nodes.speaker: Cameraman
nodes.text: Stand right there. So I can capture the players and coaches on the sidelines behind you for, um, proportion.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's weird... It looks like the camera's pointed over my head...

nodes.speaker: Cameraman
nodes.text: Yeah, it always looks like that.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh... Well, what should I say?

nodes.speaker: Cameraman
nodes.text: Whatever comes naturally...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Um...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're going to be the Homecoming King! Of course it's awesome!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Congratulations!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks! I knew you'd be excited! We're going to get to go on a vacation!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Gotta go!
Howard runs back onto the field...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If I win...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If I don't win, you're going to go on a vacation with `another` girl!
nodes.text_bbcode: If I don't win, you're going to go on a vacation with [color=#3b78e2][i]another[/i][/color] girl!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But you're probably going to win... In the meantime, can't you just be happy for me?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's hard to be happy when there's a chance you could end up kissing Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Why would I be kissing Taylor?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, I... I mean... You'd be all alone in a romantic place...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And you think I'd kiss Taylor, just like that!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, no... I just... I'm worried you might that's all.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's not something `I'd` do...
nodes.text_bbcode: That's not something [color=#e23b3b][i]I'd[/i][/color] do...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I've gotta go.
Howard turns and runs back onto the field...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Still...
On the other side of the float, Taylor is flirting with three boys at the same time!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Wow! That was a totally funny joke! How would an octopus and a whale even `do` that! You guys are so clever! Just remember to vote for me!
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow! That was a totally funny joke! How would an octopus and a whale even [color=#3b78e2][i]do[/i][/color] that! You guys are so clever! Just remember to vote for me!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm worried...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What are you going to do about Taylor?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, time to set your worries aside... The game's about to start!
A few minutes later, $ZOE and the rest of the cheerleaders are standing on the sidelines, cheering the football team as they run across the field for introductions!
Howard comes running over...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE! Guess what?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I've been hearing a lot of talk about people planning to vote for me for Homecoming King! I think I'm going to win!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I had to tell you! Isn't that awesome news?!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Come on, $ZOE, you're being ridiculous!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I am?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yes! Howard isn't going to leave you for Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: She isn't even remotely his type!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, what if his type changes? Guys change all the time, don't they?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: One day they want eggs for breakfast, the next they want doughnuts!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What if `I'm` eggs?! I can't compete with doughnuts!
nodes.text_bbcode: What if [color=#3b78e2][i]I'm[/i][/color] eggs?! I can't compete with doughnuts!

nodes.text: Sam pinches $ZOE's arm.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ow! I didn't say I was dreaming!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, well, you were being annoying.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry... I guess I did get carried away there.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Why does that matter?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: After France and Matteo, I know how easy it is to fall for someone... Especially when you're hundreds of miles away, somewhere romantic.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's true. It's a lot easier to fall for a guy when you're tanning on a tropical beach and being served drinks with umbrellas in them.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Aren't you and Howard pretty solid, though? I heard he's done some really romantic things for you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He has...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Is it just me... Or has Taylor actually gotten worse?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Definitely. This Homecoming Princesses thing has really triggered her competitive side! Now that Astrid isn't here to draw all her anger, I'm suddenly the cause of all her problems...
Earlier in the week...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: How dare you make your campaign poster the same color as mine?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What? My poster is green... Yours is blue.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Semantics! They're similar! I demote you one level in the cheer pyramid!
Later, in class...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Here! Have a cupcake, Zach. Don't forget to vote for me!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Food! Thanks, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hey! Zach already said he'd vote for me!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Vote? Is there an election...?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm just campaigning, Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh, I `know` what you're doing! That's another level you just lost yourself!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, I [color=#3b78e2][i]know[/i][/color] what you're doing! That's another level you just lost yourself!

nodes.text: And the day before Homecoming, in cheer practice...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Why is the pyramid leaning so much?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm too small to hold up this much weight!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You're saying the girls above you are fat?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, you're not exactly razor-thin after that crepe-feast you had in France!
The present...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Why don't you just drop out of the running for Homecoming Queen? Taylor would probably be a whole lot nicer to you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't drop out!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Whoever wins goes on a tropical vacation with the Homecoming King! I don't want to say anything mean about the other Princes, but I think Howard's going to win...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Zach is popular, but only with the popular kids. Ben's kind of cool, but he's still new. And Erik...
Erik peddles by on his bicycle...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Vote for Erik! Vote for America! Vote for Paul Revere!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I see...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm just worried that Howard will fall for someone else if he's...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What do you think?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But if we draw straws, there's a chance I might not end up on the throne at all!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's the point! We randomly decide who gets the throne!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But I could end up on a haystack! Or worse, standing around like some invisible Sara!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Hey! I'm not invisible!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: This idea sucks! I'm not going to do it!
Taylor wanders away, yelling at no one in particular.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What do we do?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We'll figure something out later I guess...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What do you think?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If we make the haystacks bigger, we can be higher than Taylor, even while she sits on the throne!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I like it.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Yeah, that seems really fair, as long as I get a haystack too.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What do you think, Taylor?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It's not my first design instinct. Or even my second or third for that matter. But fine. We'll go with this... As long as I get the throne.
Sam pulls $ZOE aside...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh. Let me guess... You can't kiss Howard for, like, two seconds!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Something like that...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Why don't you just leave her alone and show us this float we're supposed to be so excited about?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Why don't you go find your boyfriend, Colt...? If you `can...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Why don't you go find your boyfriend, Colt...? If you [color=#3b78e2][i]can...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Why don't you mind your own business?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Fine! I will!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Voila!
Taylor unveils the float! A throne stands tall in the center, flanked on either side by two tiny piles of hay. One is marked '$ZOE', the other 'Sam'.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What do you think?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Who is supposed to sit on the throne?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I am, of course!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Where are `we` supposed to sit?
nodes.text_bbcode: Where are [color=#3b78e2][i]we[/i][/color] supposed to sit?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: The haystacks are for you!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's completely unfair! It makes you look like the Queen already!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So?! We already know I'm going to win!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No! We don't!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: How come there are only three seats?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I don't see why that's a problem... Do we need extras or something?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sara doesn't have a seat!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh... I keep forgetting her.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'm standing `right` here!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm standing [color=#3b78e2][i]right[/i][/color] here!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Perfect. You're an experienced stander. You can stand on the float!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And it's not fair for your `throne` to be so far above our `stacks of hay!` We'll look like your servants!
nodes.text_bbcode: And it's not fair for your [color=#3b78e2][i]throne[/i][/color] to be so far above our [color=#3b78e2][i]stacks of hay![/i][/color] We'll look like your servants!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It's so like you to be critical of `my` design choices! Why don't you go find a gutter to swim in, Quitter?!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's so like you to be critical of [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] design choices! Why don't you go find a gutter to swim in, Quitter?!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I only quit cheerleading because of awful leadership!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: How dare you?!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You're not going to sit in a `throne,` Taylor!
nodes.text_bbcode: You're not going to sit in a [color=#3b78e2][i]throne,[/i][/color] Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, you're `going` to sit on the hay!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, you're [color=#3b78e2][i]going[/i][/color] to sit on the hay!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: There's got to be a way to appease Taylor `and` be fair!
nodes.text_bbcode: There's got to be a way to appease Taylor [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] be fair!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know... Um... Let's...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: The Italian guy you met in France?! Do you still have feelings for him?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Shh!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Who does $ZOE have feelings for?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Do you have feelings for someone `other` than Howard, $ZOE?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Do you have feelings for someone [color=#3b78e2][i]other[/i][/color] than Howard, $ZOE?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh my gosh! Is this real? Is this another nightmare?! How do I know I'm not dreaming now?!
Taylor reaches out and pinches $ZOE's arm!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ow! Thanks, Taylor. I guess I'm not dreaming...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: How do you know that?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Um... You pinched me, and I didn't wake up?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh! Is that a thing? I just pinch people when they're being annoying!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Now tell me about these feelings!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's nothing... Just some bad dreams I've been having about... Uh... Howard.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Really? What kind of dreams?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Dreams where he's unfaithful.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, well, I think every girl has dreams about their guy being unfaithful. It comes with the territory of being a girlfriend.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm sure it's no big deal. Dreams are just that... Dreams.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's only a problem when your dreams have a chance of being reality. When your guy's not the committing type. I wasn't exactly surprised when Colt cheated on me.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But come on, we're talking about `Howard!`
nodes.text_bbcode: But come on, we're talking about [color=#3b78e2][i]Howard![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks... That does make me feel less worried.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What is $ZOE worried about now?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's nothing... Just some bad dreams I've been having about Howard.
Taylor glares at $ZOE for a second...
She takes an imposing step toward $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You can't beat me, $ZOE... And I'm ordering you to go work on The Fling! Now!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I know you're too nice to do anything about it...
Taylor turns around and heads toward the stage for the tiara ceremony...
A few minutes later... $ZOE steps into the empty gym.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Three... Two... One... Fling!
$ZOE does a flip, landing on her feet.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's one.
Later... At the dance...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: And this year's Homecoming Queen is... Taylor! Have fun on your trip with Howard!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Thank you to everyone! Except the people I don't like!
In the gym... $ZOE does another flip.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's... Seven thousand eight hundred and twelve!
Taylor won! And $ZOE is doing flips for eternity! It's apparent...
$ZOE has failed...
Try again and see if you can argue some reason into Taylor!
You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

format.pattern: You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.text: Taylor starts laughing!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: When did you become my therapist?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Please? Could you just try?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Fine... Whatever, new girl. I'll play your game.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: How I'm acting...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Is exactly who I am! It's who I've always been!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And who I've always been is frankly better than you'll ever be!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're a part of the popular crowd... The cool kids. But part of being with the cool kids means acting cool.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Cool isn't just wearing the latest fashion and doing cool things. It's also an attitude.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And your attitude `isn't` cool...
nodes.text_bbcode: And your attitude [color=#3b78e2][i]isn't[/i][/color] cool...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Are you acting...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Cool?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Why don't you step back for just a second and ask yourself if how you're acting is...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Really? That's the best you could come up with?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well... `I` wouldn't want to be bossy...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well... [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] wouldn't want to be bossy...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No kidding! I'm bossy because I'm the cheer captain... The leader... `The boss.`
nodes.text_bbcode: No kidding! I'm bossy because I'm the cheer captain... The leader... [color=#3b78e2][i]The boss.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: If I wasn't bossy all the time, nothing would get done!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Like right now, I need the stunt we've been working on to be perfect, so I'm being bossy to you, so that we won't look like amateurs!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Manipulative?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah... You're always using people to get what you want.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Like you didn't ask how any of the Princesses felt about you having a throne on the float...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You just brought it and then tried to convince us why you should sit in it.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well... I want to win!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Why can't you just win like a normal person?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I am winning like a normal person! This is how normal people compete!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Not everyone is a perfect little angel!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... The most...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Bossy?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well... Of all the girls in Centerscore, at least I don't have a reputation for being the most...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Afraid? What do `I` have to be afraid of?
nodes.text_bbcode: Afraid? What do [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] have to be afraid of?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm popular! Guys like me! Girls want to be me!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: My hair has been voted 'Best Hair', like, every year `including` the year Amanda dyed it orange!
nodes.text_bbcode: My hair has been voted 'Best Hair', like, every year [color=#3b78e2][i]including[/i][/color] the year Amanda dyed it orange!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're afraid that you might actually lose to me because of all the bridges you've burnt with your attitude!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You don't know what you're talking about!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So what? I'd rather be mean than a supposed goody-goody like you who `cheats` on her man the second he's not around!
nodes.text_bbcode: So what? I'd rather be mean than a supposed goody-goody like you who [color=#3b78e2][i]cheats[/i][/color] on her man the second he's not around!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Gasp!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh, yeah... I heard all about that.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... You're...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Mean?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're just trying to keep me off-stage during the ceremony because you're...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I have to get some tools, but they're all in my locker!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay... Let's go!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No... Denni can come with me... You've done enough. It doesn't make sense for both of us to sacrifice our spot on the stage.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'll meet up with you after the Homecoming Ceremony!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Got it... Thanks, Ben!
Ben and Denni take off towards the school buildings!
$ZOE heads toward the stage, but... Taylor is standing there, blocking her!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We have to report to the stage...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No! I think you should go work on your form for The Fling!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No... You're right. It isn't more important.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'll do it!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Faux pas!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What? You mean you guys aren't actually dating?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No... We're just... We're like...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It's hard to define.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm going to go now...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: To help?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah... And to get out of this horribly awkward moment!
$ZOE runs to the library and finds...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Phil? Shouldn't you be at the game?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: I should, I know... But ever since I hurt my ankle, I just can't stop reading!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Also... I couldn't bear the thought of watching my team without being able to help...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: How are we doing? How's Spencer doing?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We're not doing good, but Spencer is! There's still hope! Gotta go!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Where do I look now?!
$ZOE heads over to detention and finds...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh, hey, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What are doing here, Erik? Aren't you a Homecoming Prince? Why aren't you at the game?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I wanted my campaign to reach everyone, good `and` bad, so I popped on into detention!
nodes.text_bbcode: I wanted my campaign to reach everyone, good [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] bad, so I popped on into detention!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Turns out Ms. Lee let everyone go so they could all watch the game!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What are you still doing here then?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I wanted to see what it was like...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm having oodles of fun pretending I'm a bully who got on the wrong side of the administrators... I like to pretend I did something extra naughty like loitering or unhealthy dieting!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Cool. I've gotta go!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Where do I look now?
$ZOE heads into the school hallway and finds...

nodes.speaker: Zombie
nodes.text: Braaaaains!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `AHHHHHHH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]AHHHHHHH![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zombie
nodes.text: `AHHHHHH!` What is it? Why are you screaming at me?!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]AHHHHHH![/i][/color] What is it? Why are you screaming at me?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, I'm sorry... You frightened me.

nodes.speaker: Zombie
nodes.text: It's just a costume. I was practicing. Halloween's coming up and all. Hey, why aren't you watching the game?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I gotta go!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Wow! They look...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Beautiful? Stunning? Gorgeous?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: All of the above!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I was going to write-in a vote for you, $Travis!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Heh! That'd be funny if I won Homecoming Queen...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: But now... I'm definitely voting for one of `them`. I just don't know which one...
nodes.text_bbcode: But now... I'm definitely voting for one of [color=#e23b3b][i]them[/i][/color]. I just don't know which one...

nodes.speaker: Computer
nodes.text: You would not vote for me? Am I not pretty?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Grrrr! Don't your batteries `ever` die, Robot Girlfriend?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Grrrr! Don't your batteries [color=#e23b3b][i]ever[/i][/color] die, Robot Girlfriend?!

nodes.text: $ZOE, Sam, and Sara climb up onto their raised haystacks...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's nice up here!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, we can really see a lot!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I can see the pool from here!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Who wants to see stuff when you're on a throne?!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Why don't you just tell us what you can see from down there, Taylor?!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I can see the field!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We can too!
The Homecoming Princesses take their places on the float...

nodes.prompt: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

nodes.text: The float drives around the field, passing in front of the Centerscore crowd!
The float continues around the field, passing in front of the Wilson crowd!
As $ZOE looks into the crowd, she looks for anything suspicious...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Come on... There's gotta be something!
At that moment, she sees Steve on the sidelines, talking to the cameraman. Steve is holding a walkie-talkie!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Why are `they` talking?
nodes.text_bbcode: Why are [color=#3b78e2][i]they[/i][/color] talking?

nodes.text: Steve says something and then rushes out toward a van in the parking lot!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh my gosh... Sam!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I think Wilson High is stealing our plays!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What?! How?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: They're using the cameraman as an excuse to film over Coach's shoulder!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Are you serious?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah! Steve's got a van in the parking lot! He sees the plays and then he radios them to someone on the Wilson bench!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm going to kill him!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh yeah, I forgot... Sam's hated Steve ever since...
Fourth of July...
The swim team runs toward the water! Jane, Hannah, and Linda dive in and swim off! Steve stops in front of Sam, his water gun trained on her.

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Well, what's it going to be?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Grrr... I'll remember this!
Sam reluctantly dunks herself in the water!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Hehehehe! The power!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What are you idiots blathering about over there?! We're supposed to look like royalty! And royalty doesn't talk during photo-ops!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What do we do?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't know about you, but I'm about to jump off this float and figure out how to break into that van!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I need to calm Sam down so she doesn't let Wilson know we're onto them!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Grrr!
Sam starts to jump off the float toward the parking lot!
$ZOE tackles her!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `ACK!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]ACK![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Get off of me! Let me at him!
In the crowd...

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: They're fighting! I thought they were supposed to be Princesses!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Not very lady-like at all. I like it!
Back on the float...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Why are you fighting me?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Calm down... Just breathe... Relax...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are you calm?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah... I'm calm!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Good...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We've gotta get an army together! Kill Wilson!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No... We should talk to the guys first before we do anything crazy! We should tell Howard!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay... Fine... We'll tell Howard...
Just outside the door to the locker room...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE! Sam! What are you doing here?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You look nice all dressed up, Howard!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks! I have to for the Homecoming King announcement...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But not everyone around here is nearly as... Clothed.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We know, but we had to tell you...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wilson is stealing your plays!
Spencer overhears...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: They're using the cameraman to film the plays Coach picks! Steve sees them on a monitor and then radios them in from a van!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Those weasels! That totally figures! No wonder!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Come on, Spencer! Let's tell Coach!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Wait! Don't tell anyone!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What? Why not?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: We want to keep this a secret. We still have the element of surprise on our side! We can use this against them!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: How?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ben! He can do that thing they do in heist movies where he makes the video show something from earlier! Wilson will think we're running plays we aren't!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Nice plan, Spencer!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Heh.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That `is` a good plan, but I don't know... Won't that be cheating too? Won't we be just as bad?
nodes.text_bbcode: That [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] a good plan, but I don't know... Won't that be cheating too? Won't we be just as bad?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What? They're ahead of us now because they cheated! Using their tricks against them will make things even!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It's the only `fair` thing to do!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's the only [color=#e23b3b][i]fair[/i][/color] thing to do!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hmmm... I guess that makes sense!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But then there's the matter of the Homecoming King ceremony... And the game starts soon!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No problem... Sam and I can go find Ben!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks, $ZOE! You're the best!
Back at the field...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Where are we going to find Ben?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: He's kind of nerdy, right? Maybe he's in the library.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He's not exactly nerdy. I mean, he pranked Wilson! He might be in detention!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Where should I look?
Where do you look for Ben?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Where do you look for Ben?

nodes.text: Back on the sidelines...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I thought this was supposed to be a difficult stunt! Why ban it if it's so easy?!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: It's easy because $ZOE is the best! And she totally followed my advice!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, um... Thanks, Amanda!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Look, the crowd is totally pumped up!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Eat it even more, Wilson High!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That looked painful!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: $ZOE? Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, I'm fine. All I bruised was my ego.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: At least you woke up the crowd with your clown act!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: That was so funny! Did everyone see that?!
$Scott steps onto a stage at midfield...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Will the Homecoming Princesses please report to their Homecoming Float?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: And will the Homecoming Princes please report to the stage for the exciting announcement of the Homecoming King?
On the sidelines, the cameraman sits on a bench, his camera beside him.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He wasn't even filming during my stunt!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Something about that cameraman is so suspicious... Plus Wilson can't be `this` much better than us at football...
nodes.text_bbcode: Something about that cameraman is so suspicious... Plus Wilson can't be [color=#3b78e2][i]this[/i][/color] much better than us at football...

nodes.text: $ZOE heads over to detention and finds...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh, hey, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What are doing here, Erik? Aren't you a Homecoming Prince? Why aren't you at the game?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I wanted my campaign to reach everyone, good `and` bad, so I popped on into detention!
nodes.text_bbcode: I wanted my campaign to reach everyone, good [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] bad, so I popped on into detention!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Turns out Ms. Lee let everyone go so they could all watch the game!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What are you still doing here then?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I wanted to see what it was like...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm having oodles of fun pretending I'm a bully who got on the wrong side of the administrators... I like to pretend I did something extra naughty like loitering or unhealthy dieting!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Cool. I've gotta go!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Where do I look now?
$ZOE heads into the school hallway and finds...

nodes.speaker: Zombie
nodes.text: Braaaaains!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `AHHHHHHH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]AHHHHHHH![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zombie
nodes.text: `AHHHHHH!` What is it? Why are you screaming at me?!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]AHHHHHH![/i][/color] What is it? Why are you screaming at me?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, I'm sorry... You frightened me.

nodes.speaker: Zombie
nodes.text: It's just a costume. I was practicing. Halloween's coming up and all. Hey, why aren't you watching the game?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I gotta go!
She takes a step back...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Maybe you're right...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Seriously?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Seriously. Maybe I've been... More Taylor than is good for anyone.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Just don't tell the girls...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I won't say a thing!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And you're coming in on the weekend to work on The Fling!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Just kidding!
$ZOE and Taylor step onto the stage with Sam and Sara for the Homecoming Announcement.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: And now... I present to you...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: This year's Homecoming Princesses!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Psst, $ZOE, did you find Ben?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I did! I just hope he gets there in time!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: And this year's Homecoming King...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know what to hope for!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: ...Is Howard!
And a few minutes later, the second half of the game begins...
$ZOE heads toward the stage, but... Taylor is standing there, blocking her!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We have to report to the stage...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No! I think you should go work on your form for The Fling!
$ZOE stands on the sidelines with the cheerleaders... And waits...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Come on, Ben... Where are you?
On the first play, the Wilson players blitz Zach... And sack him!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Psst! $ZOE!
Ben is leaning over the railing of the stands!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ben! What happened?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I need your help!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I've got access to the feed to Steve's monitor, but I need to get some footage to loop!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Where are we going to get that?
Ben holds up a camera!
A minute later, $ZOE is standing with a playbook in hand, while Ben films over her shoulder...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Do I look like Coach?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Not even a little bit, but all we need is for your `shoulder` to look like Coach. Try to be more manly.
nodes.text_bbcode: Not even a little bit, but all we need is for your [color=#e23b3b][i]shoulder[/i][/color] to look like Coach. Try to be more manly.

nodes.text: $ZOE throws her shoulders back...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Perfect!
Ben starts operating a small computer...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I set the feed to Steve's monitor on a loop... It's always going to play the sequence we just filmed!
Ben points toward the field...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Watch this! They'll think we're running a different play.
The Wilson players blitz again, but Zach dumps the ball off to Jacob, who runs it all the way downfield for a touchdown!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Hey! That's not the play you were supposed to run!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Shut up, stupid!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Uh... I meant... You suck, that's all.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You guys having trouble `cheating?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You guys having trouble [color=#e23b3b][i]cheating?![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Back on the sidelines, the cameraman picks up his camera and sprints away! In the parking lot, Steve's van drives off!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, Wilson knows we're onto them... So, it's up to our guys to win it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Great work, Ben! Hey, where's Denni?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh... Uh... She had to go.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Everything okay?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I can never tell with her. There's one other thing...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, I've gotta get back to cheerleading! Tell me later?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Yeah. Don't forget...
In the fourth quarter, Centerscore is down by four and time is dwindling...
Unfortunately, Wilson has the ball!
Alexei snaps it, steps back...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Grrrr!
And Spencer sacks him! The ball pops loose, and he picks it up and runs it in for a touchdown!
Centerscore wins!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Look! Spencer kept the ball!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What's he doing?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It looks like he's running over to us!
Spencer takes off his helmet...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Sam!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Nice play, Spencer!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Thanks! You want to go to the dance with me?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'll pick you up at eight!
Spencer runs off!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Looks like you've got a date, cousin!
Howard runs over...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE, can I talk to you for a second?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sure, Howard...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I saw a lot of activity on the sidelines today...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I think you probably deserved this...
Howard hands $ZOE the game ball!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Heh. Come here.
Howard holds $ZOE close and gives her a kiss!
What a great moment for $ZOE and for Centerscore High!
And all thanks to you! You helped $ZOE deal with Homecoming drama `and` win the Homecoming Game!
nodes.text_bbcode: And all thanks to you! You helped $ZOE deal with Homecoming drama [b]and[/b] win the Homecoming Game!

nodes.text: But who will win Homecoming Queen?!
This year's vote comes down to `you!`
nodes.text_bbcode: This year's vote comes down to [b]you![/b]

nodes.text: And things are just the same! Everywhere the offense tries to go, the defense is right there!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: You guys want to just give up?!

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: Haha! Not much of a Homecoming!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Yeah, more like a Home`losing!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, more like a Home[color=#e23b3b][i]losing![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE, what happened to your big plan?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know! Something must have gone wrong with Ben!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, let's go get Steve now while we still can!
$ZOE and Sam run to the parking lot, but as soon as Steve sees them, he drives off!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Look! He left behind his walkie-talkie!

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: Steve? Are you there?
$ZOE picks up the walkie-talkie...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ben? Is that you?

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ben?! Why were you talking to Steve?!

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: He's really friendly!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But he isn't your friend! He's the enemy!

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: Well... I agree with you `now.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well... I agree with you [i]now.[/i]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You cost us the Homecoming Game!
The next night... At the dance...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: We won't be announcing a Homecoming Queen this year... Since this year's been more of a Home`losing.`

nodes.text: Later that week... In the hall...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, Hector, have you seen Howard?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh... He said he wanted you to meet him out on the football field...
$ZOE heads out to the football field...
In the distance, she sees Howard sitting on a bench next to another girl!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No!
$ZOE keeps running toward them. She can hear the echo of their voices across the field...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You're, like, super cute.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You and $ZOE aren't `meant` for each other... Not like we are.
nodes.text_bbcode: You and $ZOE aren't [color=#3b78e2][i]meant[/i][/color] for each other... Not like we are.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No! No! No!
$ZOE runs as fast as she can!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You want to be with me?!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: This is the way it was always meant to be, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Now there's no one to keep us apart. We're just two people. Nothing can separate us now.
Before $ZOE can react, Taylor leans in and kisses him!
He does not resist.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard...

nodes.text: The Homecoming Princesses take their places on the float...
She takes a step back...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Maybe you're right...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Seriously?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Seriously. Maybe I've been... More Taylor than is good for anyone.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Just don't tell the girls...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I won't say a thing!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And you're coming in on the weekend to work on The Fling!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Just kidding!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: And now... I present to you...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: This year's Homecoming Princesses!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Psst, $ZOE, did you find Ben?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I did! I just hope he gets there in time!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: And this year's Homecoming King...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know what to hope for!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: ...Is Howard!

Let's see how things went for Ben after he and Denni separated from $ZOE!
After grabbing his backpack from his locker, Ben and Denni race from the school toward the parking lot! They crouch down in between two cars...
Huff... Which one is Steve's van?
Huff... Huff... It's the white one over there! I just have to get close enough so that I can use this!
Ben takes a small computer out of his backpack...
It'll get me access to the monitors in the van, so that we can upload a false video.
How close do you have to get?
Well... That's the problem... I need to get pretty close. Like... within ten yards.
Do you want to just knock on the van's door?
Heh. How would that go? 'Hello, Steve. Could you please turn on this device and ignore any flickering on your video monitors?'
Heh... Any other bright ideas, Genius?
We could park another car right next to his.
Great. Do you have another car in that backpack of yours?
No...
I think I've got a better plan...
Denni bounds up to her feet and takes Ben's hand, pulling him toward the van.
Uh... What are we doing?
Just hide that computer...
They get closer and closer to the van...
I don't like this!
With a swift movement, Denni slams Ben against the back of the van!
Hey!
She pulls him close and starts tousling his hair, twisting her head back and forth!
Heh... Hot!
What are you doing?
Shh... From his point of view, it looks like I'm kissing you!
Oh... Oh!
Is this close enough?
Yes... It's, um, very close.
Ben powers on the computer... A few seconds later...
I'm in.
What next?
We still need to get footage to put into the feed...
Come on!
Ben takes Denni's hand and heads off toward the football field. As soon as they're out of Steve's hearing range...
That was amazing! Great plan!
Thanks! I can't believe that worked!
Ben stops.
No... I'm serious... I don't know if I would have been able to do that without you.
I haven't exactly had the best start to my school year.
You might have set a record for student misery...
But you've been... You `are...` Here for me, when no one else is.
Ben leans forward and kisses Denni, tenderly holding her face in his hands...
Denni stops, looking down...
We shouldn't...
But she doesn't move away, instead letting Ben hold her.
After a long time... They separate...
Whoa! Ben and Denni kissed! Hope you enjoyed your bonus scene!

nodes.subtitle: Can $ZOE win the game from the sidelines?

nodes.text: As the sun is setting on the day of the big Homecoming Game, Taylor leads $ZOE, Sam, and Sara out toward the Homecoming Princesses' parade float!
The float rests under a tarp near the football field. Nearby, people are scrambling about trying to get everything set up for the game!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm really excited to see the float, Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Of course you are! But you're excited by everything... You're the only girl who squeals when I announce stretching time in cheer practice.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I `like` limbering up...
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]like[/i][/color] limbering up...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Whatever. For once, you're right to be excited. The other cheerleaders slaved away on the float all week!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Wait... How come you didn't ask any of us to help? Or at least $ZOE since she's a cheerleader?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Um... Because Princesses are too delicate for manual labor of course! You're part of an elite group now!
Sam whispers to the other girls...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Why do I feel like she's got another reason for not letting the three of us see this thing until now?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Come on, Sam, she took on the design of the float all by herself!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's what worries me.
$ZOE yawns...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You okay? You look a little... Worn.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I haven't been sleeping well lately. I keep having these awful dreams about...

nodes.text: I don't remember voting... I totally was going to vote for Sam. But I guess there's no point now that Taylor's already won!
